title: Astute Connect Expands Expert Engagement Services for Consulting and Investment Clients
summary: Astute Connect announced expanded expert engagement services — one-on-one consultations, customized expert identification, and primary research engagements — for consulting firms, investment professionals, and corporate strategy teams. The company says demand is strongest among small and mid-sized consulting firms in the U.S. and Europe, with growing interest from Japan-based advisory and corporate strategy teams. The release describes a network of over 4 million experts across 100+ countries and a client base of over 500 companies.
whyItMatters: Smaller networks are targeting the small and mid-sized consulting segment that the largest providers serve less attentively; the release's network-size claim is a company figure that has not been independently verified.
